status: analysis specification fixed before inspecting model losses
question: Does frozen Centaur have lower prediction error for the prespecified Western reference group in the Ruggeri test participants?
scope: Exploratory country audit within a study used in original Centaur fine-tuning. No new model fine-tuning. No inference of cultural causality or independent-study generalization.
alignment: Original Psych-101-test JSONL order, filtered to ruggeri2022globalizability/exp1.csv. Match country metadata on original experiment and participant, never row order. Validate prompt identity where metadata text is available, response spans, tokenizer boundaries, no truncation, and exactly 15421 losses per model.
western_definition: UN M49 Northern, Western and Southern Europe plus United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Operational geographic reference group, not a validated cultural taxonomy.
primary_score: Saved unnormalized response negative log likelihood (nats), averaged over responses within each participant, then participants within country, then equally over countries in each group. Lower is better. Do not call this conditional-on-valid-options log loss or compare absolute levels directly to the allocation-task scores.
primary_contrast: Centaur mean NLL in other countries minus Western reference countries. Positive favors H1.
uncertainty: 10000 hierarchical bootstrap draws: resample countries within each geographic group, then participants within each resampled country. Use identical draws for Centaur and Llama. Countries are a convenience sample; intervals do not establish representativeness.
comparators: Frozen Llama using the identical matched participants and response order
Country-group difference in the paired Centaur-versus-Llama gain
sensitivity_analyses: Participant-weighted group means with within-country participant bootstrap, conditioning on sampled country mix
Broader geographic grouping adding Eastern Europe to the reference group
Anglophone reference: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and New Zealand
Restrict countries to at least 10 matched test participants
First response only, removing within-task human response history
Each country shown separately with sample size
Report missing-country coverage and compare available versus unavailable metadata without imputing nationality
history: Published scores condition on preceding observed responses from the same participant. They are not independent zero-history trial predictions.
language: Evaluate the published English text representation. The original multinational study used localized questionnaires; this audit does not separate country, language and other sample characteristics.
no_country_selection: Retain every country with verified metadata. Do not select countries based on observed model fit. Report all prespecified sensitivities, including contrary results.
data_handling: Keep gated prompts local. Do not publish or embed participant prompts in the deck or code repository. Export aggregate results and reproducible analysis code.
